title: Lithuania opens OT Cyber Range in Kaunas for industrial-system exercises, funded by US Countering Russian Influence Fund
date_note: Opening reported on 25 November by both pages; neither gives an earlier day.
summary: Lithuania's Ministry of National Defence announced that an Industrial Technology Systems cyber range (OT Cyber Range) has opened at the National Cyber Security Centre in Kaunas. Alkas.lt says 10 mln. US dollars of investment was attracted and 24 workstations are installed. Alkas.lt says the project was financed by the US Countering Russian Influence Fund.
plain: Lithuania has opened a training facility in Kaunas where specialists can practise defending industrial control systems. Alkas.lt says 10 mln. US dollars of investment was attracted and it has 24 workstations.
exec: Lithuania's defence ministry announced a new OT cyber range in Kaunas; Alkas.lt reports 10 mln. US dollars of investment was attracted.
geo_basis: location of the National Cyber Security Centre facility in Kaunas as stated by the sources

evidence.quote: Į Kauną pritrauktos 10 mln. JAV dolerių investicijų
Šiuo metu klasėje įrengtos 24 darbo vietos.

validation.note: Alkas.lt and 15min.lt both relay one Ministry of National Defence announcement of 25 November; the ministry page was not read, so treated as one source.

review.note: validation: two outlets relay one ministry release, changed corroborated to single_source; figures and funder match both pages
